title: SmartFarm YC Founder Video
content:
Hi, I'm Aryan Antal, CTO and co-founder of SmartFarm. I lead software, hardware integration, and product engineering.
Hi, I'm Chetan Kumar, CEO and co-founder. I handle product research, the web app, and talking to growers so we solve real farm problems.
We're building SmartFarm for small farmers, nurseries, and home growers. Our device measures soil moisture, temperature, and humidity, and lets you control irrigation from your phone. We have a working prototype, and about 200 farmers have told us they'd buy one.
Our goal is simple: smart farming that small growers can actually afford, not only big farms.
We're Aryan and Chetan. We're building SmartFarm to make farming smarter, simpler, and more affordable.
